title: Understand an unfamiliar repository
whenToUse: You joined a codebase and need an accurate map before changing anything.
whenNotToUse: You already know the architecture and only need a one-line fix.
promptTemplate:
GOAL:
Map how this repository is structured and where {{concern}} is implemented.

CONTEXT:
Stack hints (if known): {{stackHints}}
Do not modify files.

INPUT:
Inspect package manifests, README, src/ layout, and routing/entrypoints.

CONSTRAINTS:
- Read-only
- Prefer official configs over guesses
- Call out uncertainty explicitly

OUTPUT:
1) Architecture summary
2) Key directories/files for {{concern}}
3) Data/auth boundaries
4) Risks before editing

ACCEPTANCE:
Another engineer can locate the right files in under 5 minutes using your map.

VERIFICATION:
List the exact files you opened and quotes/paths that justify each claim.
improvedPrompt:
GOAL:
Map how authentication and session cookies are implemented.
CONTEXT:
Astro + React islands static site; no backend auth expected—confirm.
INPUT:
Read package.json, src/pages, src/stores, middleware if any.
CONSTRAINTS:
Read-only; no invented endpoints.
OUTPUT:
Architecture notes + file map + risks.
ACCEPTANCE:
Clear yes/no on whether login exists.
VERIFICATION:
Cite paths proving the conclusion.
expectedOutput: A concise architecture map with file paths and explicit unknowns.
verificationChecklist: Every major claim cites a path
failureModes: Assuming a backend that is not present
privacySecurityNotes: Do not dump .env contents into the prompt
Redact customer data in logs before sharing
